description: Header file defining the class 'ru_dummy_impl', a dummy radio unit implementation for performance and stability testing within the ocudu namespace. It includes class declarations, member functions, and references to external components related to radio unit simulation.

classes.name: ru_dummy_impl
classes.description: A class implementing a dummy radio unit for testing purposes, simulating radio behavior without connecting to actual RF hardware.

methods.name: get_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the radio unit controller interface.

methods.name: get_downlink_plane_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the downlink plane handler interface.

methods.name: get_uplink_plane_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the uplink plane handler interface.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metrics collector if metrics are enabled, otherwise nullptr.

methods.name: get_center_frequency_controller
methods.description: Returns nullptr as this implementation does not support center frequency control.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the dummy radio unit operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the dummy radio unit operation.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Provides access to the operation controller interface.

methods.name: get_gain_controller
methods.description: Returns nullptr; gain control is not implemented.

methods.name: get_cfo_controller
methods.description: Returns nullptr; CFO control is not implemented.

methods.name: get_tx_time_offset_controller
methods.description: Returns nullptr; TX time offset control is not implemented.

methods.name: handle_dl_data
methods.description: Handles downlink data for a specific sector, asserting sector validity.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Handles PRACH occasion for a specific sector, asserting sector validity.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Handles new uplink slot for a specific sector, asserting sector validity.

methods.name: defer_loop
methods.description: Defers the execution of the loop task if the radio unit is running.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main execution loop for the radio unit.
